purpose: Record applicability and evidence-backed verdicts for OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 chapter V15 (Secure Coding and Architecture) — 21 requirements — in the machine-readable decision register, with no code changes.
requiredInvariants: Every V15 requirement is either an explicit decision (APPLICABLE with PASS/FAIL, or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION with a real self-revoking condition) or is deliberately left undeclared to fall through to the honest PENDING_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW/NOT_ASSESSED default — never an explicit NOT_ASSESSED decision with no condition, since the evidence gate rejects those.
Every applicability=NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_JUSTIFICATION decision has status=NOT_APPLICABLE and vice versa, verified across the whole decisions file before every push.

A PASS or FAIL is only recorded where the underlying code (main.ts, trusted-proxy.ts, Dockerfile.api, tsconfig.base.json, the outbound fetch call sites, docs/ip/sbom-coverage-scope.json) was read and the cited pattern verified against the live tree in this pass.

A downstream FAIL that depends on another requirement's documentation gap (V15.2.1/V15.2.2/V15.2.5 on V15.1.1/V15.1.3/V15.1.4/V15.1.5) says so explicitly rather than repeating the underlying finding as if independent.
No security control is weakened; Semgrep, the pinning ratchet and every other gate stay at full strength.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
This scope changes no application code.
acceptance: docs/security/asvs-applicability-decisions.json gains exactly 17 new V15.* decisions and no duplicates; the remaining 4 V15 requirements stay undeclared (PENDING_APPLICABILITY_REVIEW/NOT_ASSESSED).
The evidence gate rejects 0 decisions; decisionsApplied increases by 17; finalPass stays false.
scripts/security/*.test.mjs stays 60/60 (JSON-only change, no script logic touched).
A file-wide applicability/status consistency check reports 0 inconsistencies before every push.
Every FAIL and PASS note cites a real file and pattern checked against the live tree in this pass.
All four V15.4 (Safe Concurrency) requirements are NOT_APPLICABLE with the same verified worker_threads-absence condition.
